```{r libraries, echo = FALSE}
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
```



## Read in postcode data
Postcode data from Code-Point® data by Ordnance Survey and downloaded from digimaps
```{r get_postcode_data, echo = FALSE}


 setwd("E:\\Projects\\RENEW\\Jo\\PANS\\Mapping_short_paper\\Data\\boundary_line\\boundaryline_4652215")

England_boundary<-vect("english_region_region.shp") %>%
  aggregate()

## Polygons
data_d<-"E:\\Projects\\RENEW\\Jo\\PANS\\Mapping_short_paper\\Data"
## Set working directory for postcode data
postcode_d<-(file.path(data_d, "Code_point", "codepoint-poly_4612799"))
setwd(postcode_d)
# Postcode data stored as .ntf
list_folders<-dir()
ind<-grep("pc_code", list_folders) 
list_folders<-list_folders[ind]

rm(ind)

## Create function to find maximum diameter of a polygon
max_diam <- function(poly) {
  h <- convHull(poly)
  coords <- crds(h)
  max(dist(coords))
}


## Read in each postcode spatial dataset
for (folder_name in list_folders){
  layers<-dir(file.path(postcode_d, folder_name))
  for (layer_name in layers){
    shapefile_name<-dir(file.path(postcode_d,folder_name,layer_name))
    ind<-grep(".shp",  shapefile_name) 
    shapefile_name<- shapefile_name[ind]
    pcs_data<-vect(file.path(postcode_d,folder_name,layer_name, shapefile_name))
    in_england<-relate(pcs_data, England_boundary, "within")
    rm( ind, shapefile_name)
    postcode_area<-expanse(pcs_data)
    postcode_min_diameter<-width(pcs_data)
    postcode_max_diameter <- lapply(1:nrow(pcs_data), function(i) {
      max_diam(pcs_data[i])
    }) %>%
      unlist()
    postcode_max_diameter <- unlist(postcode_max_diameter)
    postcode_df<-data.frame("Postcode"=pcs_data$POSTCODE,
                            "Calculated_Area"=postcode_area,
                            "min_diameter"=postcode_min_diameter,
                            "max_diameter"= postcode_max_diameter,
                            "in_england"=as.vector(in_england)
                            )
    assign(paste0(layer_name, "_postcode_geometries_df"), postcode_df)
    rm(postcode_df, postcode_area, postcode_max_diameter, postcode_min_diameter, pcs_data)
  }
}

rm(layer_name, layers,  folder_name, list_folders)
list_postcode_geoms_df<-ls(pattern = "postcode_geometries_df")

all_postcode_geoms<-do.call(rbind, mget(list_postcode_geoms_df))
rm(list= list_postcode_geoms_df)
 rm(list_postcode_geoms_df)

## Retain only English postcodes 
all_postcode_geoms<-all_postcode_geoms[which(all_postcode_geoms$in_england==TRUE),] 

mean(all_postcode_geoms$min_diameter)
sd(all_postcode_geoms$min_diameter)
quantile(all_postcode_geoms$min_diameter, probs = c(0,0.05,0.5,0.95, 1))

options(scipen=999)
mean(all_postcode_geoms$max_diameter)
sd(all_postcode_geoms$max_diameter)
quantile(all_postcode_geoms$max_diameter, probs = c(0,0.05,0.5,0.95, 1))

mean(all_postcode_geoms$Calculated_Area)
quantile(all_postcode_geoms$Calculated_Area, probs = c(0,0.05,0.5,0.95, 1))

rm(England_boundary, in_england)
```
